mg_description: Complete 3 levels of Sudoku (Easy, Medium, Hard). Playable with mouse.
tut_step_0:
Hi! Fill the grid so each number is unique per row, column, and square.
Click an empty cell to start!
tut_step_1:
To start,
click an empty cell.
tut_step_2:
Great!
Now click a number on the right.
tut_step_3:
Watch the timer!
If it runs out, the arcade challenge ends.
tut_step_4:
Do it as fast as possible.
Good luck!
